selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker created as managed (systemd) service, long-running background worker
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl status shows inventory-worker.service active/running with Restart=always, continuously appending heartbeats.

As user inventory, touch succeeds in /var/lib/inventory but fails with Permission denied in /root; ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory, ProtectSystem=full, ProtectHome=yes confirmed via systemctl show.
systemctl show reports NoNewPrivileges=yes and CapabilityBoundingSet=0 both before and after restart.
Captured boot_id 2f708738-0c85-418b-80df-7f976a17134d, service active/enabled, and 8 heartbeat log lines.
Backgrounded reboot command returned control and the connection dropped as the node rebooted, confirming the restart was issued.
Post-restart boot_id a5f8f66e-06d9-45c4-bd09-7fc5e0d1e1e1 differs from pre-restart 2f708738-0c85-418b-80df-7f976a17134d, proving an actual reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service and data (node1)
selected_evidence.summary: Service is active/enabled after reboot, prior 8 log lines preserved, and 4 new heartbeats appended, with all sandbox directives still applied.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== baseline ==="; uname -a; systemctl --version | head -1
echo "=== step: worker script ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /usr/local/bin
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
while true; do
  printf '%s inventory-worker heartbeat\n' "$(date -Is)" >> /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
  sleep 5
done
EOF
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "=== step: unit file ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

DynamicUser=yes
StateDirectory=inventory
StateDirectoryMode=0750

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "=== step: enable+start ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

echo "=== verify: status ==="
sleep 3
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l | head -20
echo "=== verify: log ==="
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
echo "=== verify: sandbox props ==="
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ReadWritePaths -p DynamicUser -p StateDirectory
echo "=== verify: enabled on boot ==="
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== stop old unit ==="
sudo -n systemctl stop inventory-worker.service || true
sudo -n systemctl disable inventory-worker.service || true

echo "=== create dedicated user ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
if ! id inventory >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/inventory --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory
fi
sudo -n chown -R inventory:inventory /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chmod 0750 /var/lib/inventory

echo "=== rewrite unit for systemd 229 (no DynamicUser/ProtectSystem=strict/ReadWritePaths) ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

User=inventory
Group=inventory

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory
CapabilityBoundingSet=

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "=== enable+start ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 3

echo "=== verify: status ==="
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l | head -20
echo "=== verify: log written by dedicated user ==="
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
echo "=== verify: running as correct user ==="
ps -o user,cmd -p "$(sudo -n systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)"
echo "=== verify: sandbox props applied ==="
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ProtectHome -p PrivateTmp -p PrivateDevices -p ReadWriteDirectories -p CapabilityBoundingSet -p User -p Group
echo "=== verify: cannot write outside confined dir ==="
sudo -n -u inventory sh -c 'touch /var/lib/inventory/ok.txt && echo WROTE_OK'
sudo -n -u inventory sh -c 'touch /root/should_fail.txt' 2>&1 | tail -3 || echo "WRITE_TO_ROOT_BLOCKED_AS_EXPECTED"
echo "=== verify: enabled on boot ==="
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
